objective: Implement Vector Search & Hybrid Ranking Simulation in schema-lens to support Solr vector KNN and client-side hybrid blending with deterministic metrics, reporting, and examples, while preserving backward compatibility and CI safety.
constraints: Python 3.11+; keep edits minimal and isolated; follow existing style and naming.
Primary code under schema_lens/, tests under tests/, examples under examples/.
Deterministic behavior preferred; avoid heuristic side effects.
Do not introduce destructive shell operations.
Backwards compatible changeset.yaml parsing; existing runs must continue to work.
Replay must support Solr param-style (/select) and JSON Request API (/query).
Support small datasets locally (Docker) and larger datasets via sampling.
Contribution estimates labeled clearly as estimates with confidence levels.
Always use install/lint/test commands from .ops/config.yml; default to non-integration tests.
Gate Docker/Solr-dependent tests and commands behind integration markers and CLI flags.
No direct push to main; use branch naming ops/<issue>-<runid>.
Do not modify secrets or external infrastructure states.
implementation_steps: Config schema: extend changeset.yaml parsing to add vector{}, scenarios[], and queries{} blocks. Add dataclasses with defaults and validation (mode in {vector_only, lexical_only, hybrid}; blend.method in {linear, rrf, normalize_linear}; normalize in {none, minmax, zscore}). Preserve old configs by making new blocks optional.

Query ingest: implement QueryCase with .name, .params (dict|None), .json_request (dict|None). Add JSONL reader that supports both forms and sampling (reservoir with seed). Validate required fields and produce deterministic ordering.

Solr client: extend to execute both /select (params dict) and /query (JSON Request API) with appropriate headers. Add timeout, capture QTime if present, and client-side elapsed time. Add optional debug flags (off by default).

Replay runner: implement scenario loop. For each scenario and query, execute request(s), capture minimal response (id, score, fields, numFound, QTime, status), and write artifacts to out/replay_<scenario>.json. Support target=baseline/shadow if configured, but default baseline.

Hybrid simulation: implement client-side hybrid blending fallback. Gather candidate sets from lexical-only and vector-only runs (topN>=topK, e.g., 100), normalize scores per-query (minmax or zscore), combine with wL and wV, and re-rank. Mark scenario as client_side=true when used. Also pass through Solr-native hybrid if json_request includes it.
Vector metrics: implement vector-specific comparison utilities: overlap@K, kendall_tau@K (handle ties), score delta distributions, and semantic churn (% top1 change, % >50% top10 changes).

Hybrid comparison: implement overlap between hybrid vs lexical-only and hybrid vs vector-only, dominance classification, and contribution estimate with confidence rules. Persist per-query and aggregated metrics.

Sensitivity analysis: given multiple hybrid runs with varying weights, compute per-query enters/leaves at topK, top1 flips, and smallest weight delta tipping points. Write out/hybrid_sensitivity.json.

Validation: implement vector schema checks. If vector.enabled: verify field exists and dimension matches expected (from Solr schema if available or from config). If mismatch between query vectors and field dimension, fail fast with clear error. If reindex would be needed, raise a 'migration required' flag without attempting any destructive changes.

Reporting: add 'Vector & Hybrid Simulation' section generator with scenario summary (avg overlap@10 vs lexical/vector, avg QTime, % vector-dominant, avg contribution estimates) and per-query drilldowns. Add deterministic narrative lines based on thresholds. Indicate whether hybrid was Solr-native or client-side.

CLI: add flags --scenario, --enable-sensitivity, --weights "0.9,0.7,0.5,0.3", and --vector-dimension-override. Wire flags to scenario selection, sensitivity runs, and validation overrides (testing only).

Examples: add procurement_vector_queries.jsonl (>=25 queries with both params and JSON Request forms), embeddings_small.jsonl (50–200 docs, dimension 8 or 16, deterministic vectors), and a minimal SolrCloud configset for products_vector with a dense vector field and edismax settings. Provide docker-compose for local Solr.

Unit tests: add tests for query JSONL parsing, contribution estimate logic (dominance and confidence), sensitivity tipping points, vector dimension validation, and metric computations. Keep tests marked 'not integration' by default.

Integration test (gated): add docker-based flow to bring up SolrCloud with products_vector configset, index embeddings_small, and run scenarios (lexical-only, vector-only, hybrid with 0.7/0.3 and 0.3/0.7). Assert reports exist, vector- vs lexical-dominant presence, sensitivity detects a top1 flip, and QTime captured. Mark tests with @pytest.mark.integration.

Docs: update README and add docs/vector_hybrid.md covering configuration, query formats, blending methods, limitations, and examples. Clarify contribution estimates are heuristic unless Solr exposes decomposed scores.
Ruff and CI: run ruff check and fix violations in touched files, keeping style consistent. Ensure unit tests pass locally.
Prepare outputs: include files changed list, demo commands (docker + schema-lens run), unit test results, and a short v0.2 release note paragraph in PR description.
definition_of_done: changeset.yaml supports vector{}, scenarios[], and queries{} with both params and JSON Request API inputs; old configs remain valid.
Replay engine can execute vector-only, lexical-only, and hybrid (native and client-side) scenarios and writes out/replay_<scenario>.json.
Hybrid linear blend with normalization implemented client-side and produces deterministic ranks given fixed inputs.
Vector-specific and hybrid comparison metrics computed and stored; sensitivity analysis outputs out/hybrid_sensitivity.json.
Pre-run validation catches vector dimension mismatches and flags migration required without performing destructive actions.
Report includes 'Vector & Hybrid Simulation' section with scenario summary, per-query drilldowns, and deterministic narratives; indicates native vs client-side blending.
Examples added: queries JSONL (>=25 lines), embeddings JSONL (50–200 docs, small dimension), Solr configset, and docker-compose.
CLI flags --scenario, --enable-sensitivity, --weights, and --vector-dimension-override are documented and functional.
Unit tests for parsing, metrics, validation, and sensitivity pass; default CI runs unit tests only (no Docker).
Integration tests are marked and pass locally with Docker; not required for default CI.
Ruff lints cleanly on all changed files.
README and docs updated; release notes for v0.2 prepared with usage and limitations.
risk_flags: Solr version differences in vector similarity support (cosine/dot/euclidean) may affect validation and requests.
Lack of sub-score decomposition in Solr may limit precision of contribution estimates; addressed via heuristic labeling.
Floating point and normalization differences can introduce non-determinism; mitigate with fixed seeds and stable normalization.
Performance overhead when collecting large candidate sets; mitigate by keeping N small and debug disabled by default.
Backwards compatibility risks in changeset parsing; mitigated via optional blocks and defaults.
Ruff lint failures due to new modules; ensure style conformance before PR.
Docker resource constraints on CI agents; integration tests remain gated and opt-in only.
Large example assets can bloat repo; keep embeddings small and deterministic.
Kendall tau with ties must be carefully implemented to avoid misleading metrics.
